meta.scope: read-only existing files; no devices, model loading, control, collection, training or inference
meta.clock: time.perf_counter monotonic seconds on same Windows host, within a run; different runs not combined on absolute axis
meta.camera_timestamp_semantics: host frame postprocess receipt; not hardware exposure
meta.state_timestamp_semantics: follower get_observation call start and return-complete; not simultaneous hardware sample instant
meta.action_timestamp_semantics: follower send_action call start and return-complete; not motor motion onset
meta.saved_controls_scope: Only the selected control tuple per saved image is present in alignment.jsonl; full 60 Hz collection cycles were counted, not all persisted
meta.execution_control_timestamp_semantics: main-process emit time after send_action returns and queue advance; not cycle boundary or actuator onset
meta.execution_prediction_timestamp_semantics: observed_at = min(state read-complete, camera receipt); prediction.monotonic = main process result retrieval/logging; inference_s times predict only, excludes later JPEG capture and IPC

cached_batch_crosscheck.method: convert raw JSON float64 to IEEE754 float32 before exact equality with official reader fixture
